title: openai-compat: passthrough seed/determinism + metadata for Responses variants; streaming stability fixes
author: Ava Chen
release_notes: Added passthrough support for seed and determinism flags on OpenAI Responses-compatible endpoints; ensure metadata fields are preserved in compatibility layer; streaming stability improvements and minor bugfixes for function/tool calling mapping.
body:
Motivation: Customers using the OpenAI Responses-style API expect deterministic controls (seed/deterministic) and the ability to pass through arbitrary metadata (request-level tags) when we proxy to Redwood models. Previously the openai-compat layer dropped or normalized some of these fields, and there were occasional stream interruptions for long-running function/tool-calling sessions. This PR aims to: 1) Add explicit passthrough for 'seed' and 'deterministic' flags across Responses variants; 2) Preserve and forward metadata (top-level 'metadata' and 'user' tags) through the compat layer and into audit logs; 3) Harden streaming logic to reduce mid-stream disconnects during function/tool calling and structured-output sessions; 4) Ensure OpenAI-compatible response shaping still maps to Redwood internal fields without losing determinism semantics. Description: Implementation touches the OpenAI compatibility adapter, the streaming transport layer, and a small addition to the audit/a11y metadata plumbing. The compat adapter now accepts and validates seed (int) and deterministic (bool) on requests that match Responses/Chat/Generate variants and forwards them to the runtime execution config. Metadata fields are now merged into the request context and emitted to the audit-log exporter with a redaction hook for PII. Streaming changes include: - keepalive ping when no token emitted for >3s during streaming generation - improved backpressure handling when tool/function call produces large intermediate payloads - retry path for transient grpc disconnects during active streams (idempotent within a single request) Compatibility notes: - If seed is provided but model does not support deterministic seeding (some tokenizers/quantized runtimes), the runtime will return a structured warning in the 'compat_warnings' field and fall back to best-effort behavior. - Deterministic=true will enable the runtime's deterministic RNG path when available; otherwise it will surface a compat warning. Tests and CI: Unit + integration tests added for Responses request shapes, metadata passthrough, streaming keepalive behavior, and an end-to-end with a toy function-calling scenario. One flaky test (streaming_integration::long_function_call) initially failed on CI due to a race; test was made deterministic by introducing a controlled yield in the harness. Checklist:
- [x] Add seed/determinism parsing to compat adapter
- [x] Forward metadata to audit logger with redaction
- [x] Streaming keepalive and backpressure fixes
- [x] Unit and integration tests
- [x] Add Linear links and update docs (compat docs updated in redwood-docs) Commits summary and reasoning are below.
commits_summary: 1) compat: add seed/deterministic passthrough and validation (Ava Chen)
2) runtime: expose deterministic RNG toggle to execution config (Miguel Torres)
3) streaming: keepalive ping + backpressure fixes + retry on transient grpc disconnects (Priya Natarajan)
4) audit: metadata emit + redaction hook + tests (Liam O'Connor)
5) tests: flaky streaming integration stabilization and new e2e function-call test (Ava Chen)
review_comments: Miguel Torres: Left a few inline comments on adapter.go re: validation -- prefer explicit type coercion and clearer error messages for invalid seed values.
Ava Chen: Responded: coerced parse implemented, returning 400-like compat error with message and internal compat_warnings array.

Priya Natarajan: Noted streaming edge case where backpressure could starve keepalive; suggested tests that simulate slow consumer. Added test simulating slow consumer and verifying keepalive pings are sent.
Liam O'Connor: Approved after audit redaction hook added and a new unit test for redaction semantics. Requested one small doc tweak to clarify behavior when deterministic=true is unsupported.
PR merged by Priya Natarajan: squash merge after CI green.
